newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower on Thursday, in line with price falls in the Chicago corn market overnight and the yen's firm tone against the dollar, local traders said.
Prices were 110 to 270 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 110 yen at 14,130 yen per tonne. Volume was 51,533 lots.

The market saw active selling by local investors, who were discouraged by the weaker CBOT market and the yen's gains, the traders said. Light technical buying emerged later, but general sentiment was bearish, they said.
